projects.title: Personal Webpage
projects.description:
-Personal web-page that displays my skills

-Front-end languages and tools used: Vue.js, CSS-grid, Vuetify, Vuebootsrap, SASS
-Concepts used: Vue hook lifecycle, Vuex store, dynamic components, local storage, routes, and views

-Back-end languages used: MySQL, MongoDB, Node.js/Express.js
-Concepts used: Salted Password Hashing, JWT token system, Authentication, Database relationship & view, mongoose

Cloud services used: Amazon EC2, MongoDB Cloud  

-Home page displays a image galley along with a section that describes all my skills in an organized matter

-Another page is dedicated for my book store that's connected to USER_API, BOOK_API, BOOK_COVER_API. I decided to break my back-end into separate components as to practice with creating a microservices type architecture. 

-I've also migrated my API's from local machine to an instance in Amazon EC2.

projects.title: EPICS Team Builder
projects.description:
Project Objectives

•Understand the existing algorithm used to automate the team formation and make it more efficient and easier to use based on given specifications
•Read input file with (possibly)  incomplete  data
•Allow adjustment of variables being processed  through the user interface (e.g. team size, number  of choices,  etc.)
•Use specifications  already stated
•Allow adjustable  weights for specifications
•Design an easy to use user-interface
•Design easy-to-read report highlighting the strengths and weakness of each team

Languages and tools used: JavaScript, React.js, SASS, Python, AWS EC2
